messages:
sara: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a compact "PrecisionIntent" abstraction to decouple runtime selection from legacy quant-profile storage. Idea: make precision decisions declarative and versioned so runtime only implements a small negotiation surface.

sara: Goals: 1) simplify runtime contract (negotiation + fallback), 2) make migrations incremental, 3) surface quality budgets to higher layers (evals/console).

jia: +1. How do we express acceptable quality loss? Needs to be machine-checkable (tests/telemetry).

mike: Perf note: on p4d-ish infra we see fp8 paths ~1.6-1.9x token throughput vs int8 for short sequences; 4-bit gives ~2.8x but higher variance. We should include perf ranges per hw class in the intent metadata.

alan: Concern: customers overriding precision for compliance/explainability. Intent model needs an explicit flag: customer_override: allow/deny. Also schema versioning (intent.v1, intent.v2).

sara: Example PrecisionIntent (draft):
```json
{
  "api_version": "precision-intent.v1",
  "name": "latency-tilt-v1",
  "targets": ["fp8", "int8", "4bit"],
  "quality_budget": "0.015", \n  "observability_keys": ["degradation_score","token_quality_delta"],
  "fallback_order": ["int8","4bit"],
  "customer_override": "allowed"
}
```

mike: Runtime surface we need: a single header or metadata field on request to declare intent, and a small negotiation response: selected precision + reason. Eg: request header `X-Precision-Intent: latency-tilt-v1`. Response header `X-Selected-Precision: int8; reason=cost-savings`.

jia: Telemetry: emit per-request fields: intent_name, selected_precision, observed_quality_delta (compared to baseline shadow), latency_tokens_ms. That lets Optimize + Console correlate cost/quality per-intent.

alan: Migration plan suggestion:
- Adapter layer: accept old quant profile, translate to best-effort PrecisionIntent
- Dual-read stage where runtime accepts both legacy profile and intent header (intent wins)
- Canary: roll precision intents to small % of traffic, collect quality deltas via shadowing / replay
- Full cutover by removing legacy path once intent coverage + SLOs met

sara: CLI / ops examples:
```
# create canary rollout for precision intent
rwctl rollout create --type precision-intent --name latency-tilt-v1 --canary 5% --metric token_latency
```

mike: For runtime impl: we should keep negotiation synchronous and cheap. Pseudocode handshake: 
```
// client -> runtime
X-Precision-Intent: latency-tilt-v1

// runtime -> client
X-Selected-Precision: int8
X-Precision-Reason: fallback_due_to_capacity
```
Also runtime should log SelectedPrecision and Intent into traces for sampling.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created rollout "latency-tilt-v1" (canary 5%) — started at 2026-03-22T15:12:34Z :rocket:

jia: Tests: add unit test harness to simulate baseline vs selected precision using small eval prompt sets; assert quality_delta < intent.quality_budget. Also add shadow sampling for first 48h of canary.

alan: Observability/Console items: show per-intent cost delta, quality delta, customer overrides (count + who toggled). We should add intent metadata to the per-route dashboards.

sara: Action items: 
- sara: draft formal schema for precision-intent.v1 (this week)
- jia: telemetry fields + unit test harness (next sprint)
- mike: runtime negotiation shim + perf annotations (spike this week)
- alan: migration plan + customer-override policy doc (EOD Wed)

sara: Anyone object to this direction? If not I'll fold into the RFC follow-up doc and add the schema PR. :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup: from infra side, just need microbench numbers per hw class to populate intent perf ranges.

jia: will start drafting telemetry spec tomorrow.

alan: will carve out time for migration doc.

sara: thanks all — I'll open the PR for the schema draft and tag you for review.
